# Test fixtures

**All files in this directory are synthetic test data**, generated by
`scripts/generate_test_fixtures.py`. Names, emails, employers, and
universities are fictional (e.g. "Jordan Testcase", "Fixture Industries
Inc.", "Sample State University") -- none of it describes a real person.
To regenerate: `pip install reportlab pillow` then run that script from
the repo root.

| File | Exercises |
|---|---|
| `normal_resume.pdf` / `.docx` | standard single-column resume, all four sections with conventional headings |
| `table_resume.docx` / `.pdf` | a ruled table under a "Skills" heading |
| `two_column_resume.pdf` | genuine two-column layout (Experience left, Skills right) |
| `unusual_order_resume.pdf` | reordered sections with brief-listed heading variants ("Core Competencies", "Employment History", "Academic History") |
| `empty_resume.pdf` / `.docx` | a document with no extractable text |
| `corrupt.pdf` / `.docx` | correct file-type magic bytes but an unparseable body -- exercises parser-level failure handling |
| `scanned_image.pdf` | a page containing only a raster image, no text layer -- exercises scanned/image-only detection |
